goal: Prevent test flakiness in interface_http when HTTP responses are fragmented across multiple socket reads
Ensures functional tests do not time out or fail on heavily loaded machines or unusual network setups
agreement: Waiting on initial feedback from reviewers

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it is a preventative fix for rare test flakiness rather than resolving an active CI disrupter
TCP fragmentation failures are unlikely in standard test runs but remain possible on loaded hosts
